content: Iesu Isimurawaiwa Mu Yaiyawa
Ebraam usiwa, Devid usiwa Iesu Keriso, Iesu Keriso isimurawaiwa mu yaiyawa tenewa:
Ebraam me Aisak baraune, Aisak me Jekob baraune, Jekob me Juda ge me tatawaiwa teyamne,
Juda me Tama gumbe Peres ge Seira teyamne, Peres me Esuron baraune, Esuron me Ram baraune,
Ram me Aminadab baraune, Aminadab me Nason baraune, Nason me Sarumon baraune,
Sarumon me Reab gumbe Boas baraune, Boas me Ruti gumbe Obed baraune, Obed me Jesi baraune,
Jesi me kin Devid baraune, Devid me Urayas biviwa gumbe Soromon baraune,
Soromon me Reoboam baraune, Reoboam me Abaija baraune, Abaija me Eisa baraune,
Eisa me Josiyapat baraune, Josiyapat me Jeoram baraune, Jeoram me Ujaiya baraune,
Ujaiya me Jotam baraune, Jotam me Eias baraune, Eias me Ejekaiya baraune,
Ejekaiya me Manase baraune, Manase me Amon baraune, Amon me Josaiya baraune,
me kumiwa Babiron amog wakeya, Josaiya me Jekonaiya ge tatawaiwa teyamne.
Namu Babiron amog wakeya, ivi Jekonaiya me Searutieru baraune, Searutieru me Jerubaberu baraune,
Jerubaberu me Abaiud baraune, Abaiud me Eraiyakim baraune, Eraiyakim me Eijo baraune,
Eijo me Jeidok baraune, Jeidok me Eikim baraune, Eikim me Eraiud baraune,
Eraiud me Erieija baraune, Erieija me Matan baraune, Matan me Jekob baraune,
sira Jekob me Meri memawa Josep baraune, Iesu mu waya Keriso me Meri gumbe yaine.

Meoya Ebraam gumbe onke Devid gumbe uwanewa, mu kum muma kumiwa undag 14. Devid gumbe onke Babiron amog wakeyawa kumiwa uwane, mu kum muma kumiwa undag 14. Sira Babiron amog wakeyawa kumiwa onke Keriso gumbe uwanewa, mu kum muma kumiwa undag 14.
Iesu Keriso Yainewa Kumiwa
Mame me Iesu Keriso aninin yaig onnewa. Me inawa Meri Josep gaibu yapapara aya, sira mu memgebip oya amareme kumiwa apa, Guwawa Iyakaisiyapama gumbe me bugane.
Megara Josep taibe me kwetan den anone, kuiyawa me apan da oraimina, meoya me imidanave me guwave kwepe aipe.
Megara Josep mameib yaug anoiviwa, Ayapan aneya meuma uyavi gumbe uwag dig wane, Josep, Devid usiwa, Meri biyugwa aug gwe aga a den a, kuiyawa me kikiyan gumbewa Guwawa Iyakaisiyapama gumbe wanedne.
Me urapan yaipe, sira ge iviwa ug Iesu yua, kuiyawa me iyayapan meuma kukaeba emewa waita mumpe.
Watavit propeta gumbe Ayapan dig wanewa natawa veniyatan oya, mame dividivi undag veniyane.
Yauya, otau inipama kikiyan gumbe wakepe, sira urapan yaipe, sira mu iviwa ug me Emanueru yupe. (Me natawa God nu gunup.)
Josep kub gumbe wan yoine, sira Ayapan aneya meuma aninin wanewa me ane, sira biviwa aune.
Megara me gaibu den nag vinne, namu me urapan kikiyan baraune, sira me iviwa ug yune Iesu.
